Claude Opus 4.8.description: Anthropic's high-capability model for complex agentic coding, enterprise workflows, and careful long-form work. Prefer it when quality matters more than latency.
features: Strong complex reasoning and agentic coding
Good for detailed writing and editing

Claude Sonnet 5.description: Anthropic's speed-and-intelligence option for day-to-day agents, coding, writing, and interactive work. Product defaults vary, so select a model alias or exact ID when reproducibility matters.
features: Best for expressive writing and brainstorming

Claude Haiku 4.5.description: Anthropic's fastest and cheapest model. Haiku 4.5 delivers near-frontier performance for high-volume, cost-sensitive tasks like classification, extraction, and quick Q&A.
features: Lowest per-token cost in the Claude family
Great for batch processing and high-volume workflows

Claude Fable 5.description: Anthropic's most capable broadly released model for long-running agents and difficult work. Use it when you need maximum capability and can accept higher latency and cost.
features: Highest-capability Claude option in the current catalog
Useful for difficult research, coding, and synthesis

Gemini 3.1 Pro.description: Google's preview reasoning model for difficult multimodal and long-context work. Preview status can change, so check the model lifecycle page before production use.
features: Better multimodal synthesis (text, images, audio, video)
Preview model: verify availability before deployment

Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite.description: Google's cheapest Gemini tier. Flash-Lite retains a long context window and runs even faster than Flash, making it a natural fit for high-volume agentic calls and cost-sensitive background automations.

Gemini 3.6 Flash.description: Google's current stable agentic and multimodal Flash model. It is the practical default when latency, throughput, and tool use matter more than maximum reasoning depth.
features: Strong multimodal input and tool use
Good for interactive agents and high-throughput workflows

Veo 3.1.description: Google's current Veo video-generation family. Availability and supported controls vary by product and API, so confirm the exact model and terms before production use.
features: Native video and audio generation options

Gemini 2.5 Pro (legacy).description: Google's previous-generation 'work' model. While still capable, Gemini 3.1 Pro is recommended for new work due to its improved reasoning and efficiency.

Gemini 2.5 Flash (legacy).description: Google's previous-generation fast 'chat' model. Gemini 3.6 Flash is recommended for new work due to better directness and efficiency.

GPT-5.6 Sol.description: OpenAI's recommended flagship for complex reasoning and agentic work. The GPT-5.6 alias resolves to Sol; pin an exact snapshot only when reproducibility is more important than automatic upgrades.
features: 1.05M-token context and up to 128K output tokens

GPT 5.4.description: An older supported OpenAI flagship. Prefer GPT-5.6 Sol for new complex agent work, or GPT-5.6 Terra/Luna when latency and cost matter more.
features: Useful where an existing integration is already qualified

Codex (GPT-5.6 Sol).description: OpenAI's coding-agent experience using GPT-5.6 Sol for complex repository work. Use explicit approval boundaries, relevant tool subsets, bounded concurrency, tests, and exact-head review gates.

Nano Banana 2.description: Google's current all-around image model, exposed as Gemini 3.1 Flash Image. Use Nano Banana 2 Lite for lower latency and cost, or Nano Banana Pro for the most complex image work.

NotebookLM.description: Google's research and writing assistant that is grounded in your chosen source documents. It helps you get summaries, ask questions, and generate ideas based only on the material you provide, reducing hallucinations.
features: Generates summaries, FAQs, and audio overviews
Excellent for analyzing collections of documents

Grok 4.5.description: xAI's current frontier model. Current web or X information requires enabling the Web Search or X Search tool; the base model is not automatically real-time.
features: Optional Web Search and X Search tools
Useful for research when sources are independently verified

Perplexity.description: An AI-powered search engine that provides direct answers to queries with citations. It's designed for research and finding information, functioning as a 'conversational search engine'.
features: Provides answers with inline source citations
Excellent for fact-checking and initial research
Focus mode for searching specific domains (e.g., academic papers)

Open source models.description: A category of open-weight models that can be run locally on your own hardware or via community-hosted providers. Frontier open models now rival closed providers on specific tasks, and they are ideal for privacy-sensitive workflows or when you need to keep source material off third-party servers.
features: Can run on local hardware (via Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM)
Current options include GLM-5.2, DeepSeek V4, Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, and Kimi K2.5
No per-token costs once running locally

GLM-5.2 (open source).description: Z.ai's MIT-licensed open-weight model for long-horizon agentic work, with a one-million-token context option. Hardware and provider behavior vary, so benchmark it on your own workload.
features: Current open-weight option for long-horizon agents

Qwen3.6-35B-A3B (open source).description: Alibaba's open-weight mixture-of-experts model with 35B total and about 3B active parameters. It is a practical efficiency-oriented option for local agentic coding and general tool use.
features: Open weights with a liberal license
Good for IDE autocomplete and refactoring

DeepSeek V4 (open source).description: DeepSeek V4 Pro and Flash are MIT-licensed open-weight models with one-million-token context. Choose Pro for maximum capability or Flash for lower latency, and migrate away from deprecated deepseek-chat and deepseek-reasoner aliases.
features: Open weights and hosted API options

Kimi K2.5 (open source).description: Moonshot AI's open-weight multimodal mixture-of-experts model for agentic coding and visual work. It supports long context and coordinated multi-agent workflows, but the full model requires substantial hardware.
features: One trillion total parameters with 32B active

ElevenLabs.description: A specialized AI tool for high-quality, realistic voice synthesis. It's the industry leader for generating voiceovers, podcast audio, and other narrated content.
features: Fine-grained control over voice emotion and pacing

Midjourney.description: A premier AI image generation service known for producing highly artistic, detailed, and aesthetically pleasing images. It operates primarily through the Discord platform.
features: Strong control over style and composition
